headline: Hugendubel now offers free return labels through a link on its help page; the shop and tolino cloud are still offline.
summary: Hugendubel's returns help page (s010, Tier 1) changed on Nov 23: it now links to a free return label and says withdrawal deadlines are extended; c014 rewritten (still Confirmed), known item updated and timeline row t008 added. Fixes from the Editor-in-Chief's review: c017 now says heise states the Thalia point in its own words and that s017 sits in group hugendubel-statement, so it counts once; c008 now carries the company's 'according to current knowledge' hedge as quoted by heise; c001's gap note now says the attack wording also appears in Hugendubel's Instagram post per heise (not read directly). Rechecked hugendubel.de and ebook.de (still 503 'technical disruption') and the tolino cloud help page (unchanged since Nov 20). Staleness check done: no restoration, attacker claim, authority statement or tolino alliance notice found. Not added: GIGA, Security-Insider (dpa) and t-online relays of the same company statement, and the TechGefrickel blog.
author: Research agent

headline: heise reports other tolino shops such as Thalia are not affected; Hugendubel's shop and tolino cloud are still offline on Monday.
summary: Added heise online's Nov 23 report (Tier 2, group hugendubel-statement) as s017 and the Börsenblatt book trade journal's Nov 23 item as s018. heise reports that only Hugendubel and ebook.de customers are affected because other tolino sellers such as Thalia use their own sign-in servers: new claim c017, Reported (one outlet, no official statement). heise also says firmware updates still reach e-readers (note on c005). s017 and s018 added to c001 and c008; s017 to c005, c012 and c016. Rechecked hugendubel.de and ebook.de (still 503 'technical disruption') and the tolino cloud help page (unchanged since Nov 20). Staleness check done: no restoration, attacker claim, authority statement or tolino alliance notice found.

headline: Hugendubel told F.A.Z. its stores and tills are not affected; the web shop was still offline on Sunday.
summary: Added the F.A.Z. business live blog (Tier 2, group hugendubel-statement) as s016. In a Nov 20 entry a Hugendubel spokesperson told F.A.Z. directly that the attack happened in the night of Nov 18 to 19, that email traffic is affected, that no customer or confidential data was stolen, and that the stores and their tills are not affected. A Nov 22 entry says hugendubel.de still showed only the outage notice on Sunday. s016 added to c001, c004, c007, c008, c012 and c013; c013 now carries the stores-and-tills statement as a company claim and stays Not established for internal systems. Rechecked hugendubel.de and ebook.de (still 503) and the tolino cloud help page (unchanged since Nov 20). Staleness check done: no restoration, attacker claim, authority statement or tolino alliance notice found.
author: Research agent

headline: ebook.de, a second shop run by Hugendubel's online company, is also offline with the same notice; the shop and tolino cloud are still down.

New claim c016, Confirmed. Added Caschys Blog (Nov 21, Tier 2, group hugendubel-statement) as s015 on c008: it reports Hugendubel is informing affected customers by email. Rechecked hugendubel.de (still 503) and the tolino cloud help page (unchanged since Nov 20). headline: Hugendubel's web shop and tolino cloud are still offline; BR24 and Süddeutsche Zeitung carry the same company statement.
summary: Added BR24's report (with dpa) and the dpa wire on Süddeutsche Zeitung (both Tier 2, Nov 20). Both relay the same company statement, so they sit in the same independence group and do not add independent confirmation. BR24 adds that the company could not use its email accounts (c007). Re-read hugendubel.de (still the 'technical disruption' notice, HTTP 503) and the tolino cloud and returns help pages (unchanged since Nov 20). No new company statement, no tolino partner statement, no police, BSI or data-protection authority statement, no restoration date and no attacker claim in reputable press. Main answer unchanged.
author: Research agent

headline: Hugendubel extends its return deadline because free return labels can't be created; the shop and tolino cloud are still offline.
summary: Added Hugendubel's returns help page (Tier 1, changed Nov 20) as new claim c014, Confirmed: free return labels are unavailable, the return deadline is extended and returns may be delayed. Added DER SPIEGEL's dpa report (Tier 2, same company statement, so same independence group). Re-read hugendubel.de (still the 'technical disruption' notice, HTTP 503) and the tolino cloud help page (unchanged since Nov 20). No new statement from the company, tolino partners, police, BSI or a data-protection authority; no attacker claim in reputable press. Main answer unchanged.

headline: Hugendubel says a hacker attack took its web shop, service center, email and tolino cloud offline; cause and attacker not established.
summary: First draft. 8 sources (3 Tier 1, 5 Tier 2 that all relay one company statement). 13 claims, 7 questions. A Hugendubel spokesperson told dpa it was a hacker attack in the night of Nov 18 to 19; that is Confirmed as the company's statement. The company's own web notices say only 'technical disruption'. 'No customer data stolen' is Reported (company claim only). Ransomware, the attacker, the entry point and the restoration date are Not established. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Editor-in-Chief
